dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam! You've been sitting here all morning!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm! juːv bɪn ˈsɪtɪŋ ˈhɪr ˈɔːl ˈmɔːrnɪŋ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know. I've been studying for my midterms since eight o'clock.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. aɪv bɪn ˈstʌdiɪŋ fər maɪ ˈmɪdtɜːrmz sɪns ˈeɪt əˈklɑːk.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Since eight? That's four hours! What are you studying?
dialogue.reading: sɪns ˈeɪt? ðæts ˈfɔːr ˈaʊərz! ˈwʌt ər juː ˈstʌdiɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Economics. My major is English, but every student in my faculty has to take economics.
dialogue.reading: ˌɛkəˈnɑːmɪks. maɪ ˈmeɪdʒər ɪz ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ, bʌt ˈɛvri ˈstuːdənt ɪn maɪ ˈfækəlti ˈhæs tə ˈteɪk ˌɛkəˈnɑːmɪks.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: How long have you been studying it?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ ˈlɔːŋ hæv juː bɪn ˈstʌdiɪŋ ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Only since June, and it's really difficult.
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊnli sɪns ˈdʒuːn, ənd ɪts ˈriːli ˈdɪfɪkəlt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: When will you finish your degree?
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛn wɪl juː ˈfɪnɪʃ jʊr dɪˈɡriː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Next year, if I pass everything!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɛkst ˈjɪr, ɪf aɪ ˈpæs ˈɛvriθɪŋ!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: You will. But you've been working too hard. Let's go and have lunch on campus.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈwɪl. bʌt juːv bɪn ˈwɜːrkɪŋ ˈtuː ˈhɑːrd. ˈlɛts ˈɡoʊ ənd ˈhæv ˈlʌntʃ ɑːn ˈkæmpəs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK. Just give me ten more minutes. I've been reading this chapter for an hour!
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ˈdʒʌst ˈɡɪv miː ˈtɛn ˈmɔːr ˈmɪnɪts. aɪv bɪn ˈriːdɪŋ ˈðɪs ˈtʃæptər fər ən ˈaʊər!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Ten minutes. I'll wait for you outside.
dialogue.reading: ˈtɛn ˈmɪnɪts. aɪl ˈweɪt fər juː ˌaʊtˈsaɪd.
